facts.statement: Koshisaurus is a single-species genus of early hadrosauroid dinosaur found in the Kitadani Formation of Japan.
facts.quote: Koshisaurus is a monospecific genus of basal hadrosauroid from the Kitadani Formation in Japan.

facts.statement: The name Koshisaurus comes from 'Koshi', an old regional name for the area in Fukui prefecture where the fossils were found.
facts.quote: "Koshi" means an old Japanese regional name including Fukui prefecture where fossils of the genus were discovered.

facts.statement: The discovery of Koshisaurus suggests that hadrosauroids were more diverse along the eastern edge of Asia during the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: The discovery of the genus suggests that hadrosauroids had higher diversity along the eastern margin of Asia in the Early Cretaceous.

facts.statement: Koshisaurus was distinct from most hadrosauroids because it had an antorbital fossa and three ridges on its upper teeth.
facts.quote: Koshisaurus was unlike most hadrosauroids due to the fact that it possessed an antorbital fossa, as well as three subsidiary ridges on its maxillary teeth, similar to those of Equijubus.

facts.statement: Other Asian genera like Xuwulong, Jinzhousaurus, and Altirhinus share the tooth ridges but lack the antorbital fossa, making them more evolutionarily advanced than Koshisaurus.
facts.quote: These ridges are also present on the also Asian genera Xuwulong, Jinzhousaurus and Altirhinus; but all three lack antorbital fossae, placing them as more advanced than Koshisaurus.

facts.statement: Koshisaurus lived in the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 128 million years ago during the Aptian age, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace 128 millones de años durante el Aptiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Fossils of Koshisaurus were discovered in the Kitadani Formation in Japan.
facts.quote: Sus fósiles fueron encontrados en la Formación Kitadani en Japón.

facts.statement: Koshisaurus belongs to the superfamily Hadrosauroidea.
The time range for Koshisaurus is estimated between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
